svg.title: Level 3, where an agent orchestrates but can't grant itself access
svg.desc: An orchestrator agent turns signals and requests into tasks and proposes each one's profile and scope to the authorization service, which alone grants access; the execution layer starts each agent in its own sandbox, and a monitoring agent watches from outside and flags new work. Changes go through approval and deploy to production, whose signals start the next work, inside the same boundaries as Levels 1 and 2.

g.text: each part to its own agent,
telemetry and evals across all runs
